selection_disclosure.observed_before_design: The exact v1 folds 29-42 diagnostic showed that immediate complete-set locks converted terminal losers but capped many more terminal winners, leaving v1 at -$8.15098 with a 0.055696 payoff ratio.
selection_disclosure.design_response: Use a trailing state: arm only after material executable complete-set profit, preserve upside above the arm, then lock only on a retreat that still guarantees the fixed minimum profit.
selection_disclosure.selection_bias_control: All folds 29-42 are ineligible for v2 promotion credit. The integrated v2 historical replay is a one-shot mechanism diagnostic only. No threshold or neighbor search is permitted, and promotion requires two post-registration disjoint fresh blocks.

parameter_provenance.reason: These exact arm and floor values were fixed three days before the v1 integrated tail run. They are reused without search; folds 29-42 did not select their numerical values.

state_machine_contract.unarmed_at_or_above_arm: set armed=true and submit no order
state_machine_contract.armed_below_arm_and_at_or_above_floor: buy exactly the held share quantity of the opposite outcome with the existing fee-inclusive taker-FOK ceiling guarantee
state_machine_contract.armed_below_floor: submit no order; retain the directional position
state_machine_contract.gap_through_floor: fail closed without manufacturing a lock
state_machine_contract.successful_lock: hold both equal legs and all capital to terminal close; no immediate merge or early collateral reuse is assumed
state_machine_contract.failed_or_partial_fill: retain the original position; a reconciliation mismatch trips the breaker and blocks promotion

economic_contract.payout_usd: one matched Yes plus No share pays exactly $1 at terminal settlement or can be merged into $1 collateral
economic_contract.signal_cost_bound: all missing-leg shares are costed at the submitted FOK ceiling and the fee is bounded at min(ceiling, 0.50)
economic_contract.order_style: missing-leg taker FOK at measured 202 ms latency
economic_contract.available_cash: maximum hedge spend and fee must fit uncommitted bankroll

historical_folds_29_42.purpose: one-shot integrated mechanism and accounting diagnostic
historical_folds_29_42.failure_action: reject v2; do not rescue it with threshold changes

evaluation_contract.fresh_block_1: first chronological post-registration block with at least 100 admissible terminal exact-replay candidate trades
evaluation_contract.fresh_block_2: second chronological, disjoint post-registration block with at least 100 admissible terminal exact-replay candidate trades and unchanged code, hash, parameters, and gates
required_properties_each_scored_block: every successful lock has realized fee-inclusive PnL of at least $0.10
no order is submitted before the position arms at executable guaranteed profit of at least $0.50
the full stateful candidate policy has higher fee-inclusive PnL than the full stateful baseline
candidate fee-inclusive total PnL is positive
candidate fee-inclusive PnL is positive in both chronological halves
candidate 95% Wilson win-rate lower bound is at least 0.70
candidate payoff ratio is at least 0.30
five-report loss burst is at most 2
20% left-tail fold CVaR is at least -$8.00
execution attempts, fills, both fees, state transitions, and unresolved exposure reconcile exactly
state_feedback_reporting: common-entry count and PnL by policy
lock PnL delta versus terminal hold

promotion_boundary.two_fresh_blocks_pass: eligible for exact live-runtime parity implementation and bounded paper preflight only
live_requirements: live runtime implements the same arm state and missing-leg lifecycle
market fee parameters and tick size match replay
venue FOK acknowledgements and fills prove exact hedge quantity
terminal redemption or merge operations are verified
fresh promotion artifact passes release preflight

forbidden_actions: change entry thresholds based on v2 results
pool historical folds with fresh blocks for a promotion score
emit a v2 strategy score below the registered fresh support floor
install this replay-only exit in the production trading binary
